title: Running a whole tutorials track should not leave a window per guide
goal: Each guide opens a sample window of its own, so somebody who does the five Redlining guides back to back ends up with five windows all called Tutorial Sample. Doing a whole track is the thing we want people to do, and it should not leave the desk covered in identical windows.
notes: Found while finishing the Redlining tutorials track (2026-09-13). TutorialLauncher.windows keys the window by GUIDE id; keying it by the sample the guide brings (TutorialSample) would give the three redlineScreen guides one window between them and the two measuredScreen guides another. Open question worth deciding first: arriving at guide two on a picture that already carries guide one measurements might be continuity or might be clutter, and a measuredScreen window that has been edited is not the list the panel guide was written for. Decide the behaviour before building it.
acceptance: Doing a whole track back to back leaves at most one sample window per kind of sample, not one per guide
A guide never teaches over a window somebody is working in, which is the rule the sample window exists for
Finishing or closing a guide leaves the sample window in a state that does not confuse the next guide
